title.zh: AgentDock Bridge · 云端 AI 会话与本机环境的 MCP 桥接工具
title.en: AgentDock Bridge · Remote MCP Bridge with Local Approval

summary.zh: 把云端 AI 会话连接到本机 Windows、macOS 或 Linux 开发目录的个人 MCP 桥接小工具，通过 Cloudflare Worker 做 OAuth 鉴权，并要求本机逐条审批后在 Linux 容器中执行命令。
summary.en: Personal MCP bridge connecting cloud AI sessions to local Windows, macOS, or Linux folders via Cloudflare Worker OAuth, local per-request approval, and Linux Docker containers.

zh: 文件读写与命令执行均须逐次批准，Linux 和 macOS 支持在本机 WebUI 中核对完整请求、切换工具权限
命令在非特权、只读根文件系统的 Linux Docker 容器内运行，不挂载宿主敏感目录与 Docker Socket
按宿主平台使用 Windows DPAPI、macOS Keychain 或 Linux Secret Service/0600 私有存储保护凭据，并校验路径安全与符号链接
en: Requires exact local approval for file and shell requests, with request review and per-tool controls in the local Linux and macOS WebUI
Runs commands inside non-privileged, read-only Linux Docker containers without mounting host sensitive paths
Protects local credentials via Windows DPAPI, macOS Keychain, or Linux Secret Service/0600 private storage and checks for symlink or path traversal

milestone.zh: 已完成 Worker 鉴权、本机审批脚本与容器隔离执行流程。
milestone.en: Worker OAuth, local approval connector, and container execution are complete.
